title: Separate list construction from indexed access
description: You inspect the two loops' different uses of a list.

steps.description: You begin with an empty grades list. The following loop changes that list.
You see append in the first loop. Its argument combines a fixed starting value with i.

steps.question: Does the second loop append values or read existing elements?
steps.answer: It reads existing elements through grades[i] and passes them to print.

steps.description: You compare the list-changing call with the indexed read. The supplied recording contains the values printed by the reading loop.
